title: AET-B-2: the durable-effect record -- terminal outcomes are terminal, the event record is closed, and the authority-check phase is witnessed
objective: Close the measured gap between AET-I05's four-phase durable-effect protocol and what the run-ledger actually enforces: an effect that reached a terminal outcome can be re-PREPARED and re-COMMITTED, and replay reports one clean commit over a durable external effect executed twice. The vocabulary constrains values but never transitions -- #290's defect one layer down -- so the fix inherits #290's remedy: one authoritative site both consumers inherit, proven by per-consumer mutation discrimination.
business_value: AET-B's second rung. The substrate already exists (hash-chained ledger, five contract resolutions, pure replay, deny-unless-established resume); this makes its central invariant enforceable rather than doctrinal, without adding a second effect-recording mechanism.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: a transition rule for effect outcomes -- an effect whose last recorded outcome is terminal cannot receive a further event -- enforced at ONE authoritative site that both the append path and the read/replay path inherit
schemas/run-ledger-event.schema.json: additionalProperties false (walker-enforced, measured live on seats.schema.json during #290)
the AUTHORITY CHECK phase witnessed in the record, so the contract's second phase leaves a trace; the sole enforcer stated in-line and the alternative justified
tests/test_badf_durable_effect.py: red-first for every refusal; the closed outcome set walked whole; per-consumer mutation discrimination with a negative control
reconcile WP-2026-0130 (composition_verified: true) -- taken as first opener of three composing lanes
out_of_scope: any executor, runtime, or retry-policy engine: this rung governs the RECORD, and the thing that performs effects gains no authority from it landing
compensation semantics -- what COMPENSATED must have done -- which stays with the operation that owns them
a second ledger or effect-recording mechanism: the hash-chained run-ledger is reused, per no-second-gate
detection-quality measurement of any kind (belongs to the families that have runtimes)
acceptance_criteria: an effect whose last outcome is terminal cannot receive a further event: refused on the append path AND on the read/replay path, from one authoritative site, with one semantic
the transition rule walks the closed LEDGER_OUTCOMES set: every member exercised as a predecessor, legal successors asserted from the declared table rather than from convenient cases
run-ledger-event.schema.json declares additionalProperties false; an event carrying an undeclared key is refused, and the refusal is attributed to the walker by measurement rather than assumed
the AUTHORITY CHECK phase is witnessed by the record; the sole enforcer is stated in-line per the #264 pattern and the choice justified against its alternative in the PR body

every new refusal is red-first, and each with two consumers is mutation-killed by per-consumer discrimination against a green negative control -- a batch run cannot distinguish a shared refusal from two independent ones

ADVERSARIAL (#270): the battery includes at least one sequence not in the declared table and not obviously illegal, and states which control refuses it or declares it non-covered; a missing WITNESS is invisible to any test that walks only the vocabulary that exists, so the clause is pointed at the authority-check gap first

test_obligations.claim: a durable effect that reached a terminal outcome cannot be recorded as re-prepared or re-committed, at either consumer; the event record admits no undeclared keys; and the authority-check phase leaves a trace
test_obligations.method: red-first against the current gate, then per-consumer mutation discrimination on each shared refusal with a negative control; the closed outcome set walked from the declared constant, not sampled

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Scoped from measurement, not imagination: the reuse survey found the substrate already present and the delta probed to three gaps with a positive control (a bogus outcome IS refused, so the two ADMITTEDs mean something). Gap 1 named as #290's class one layer down so this rung inherits that remedy rather than re-deriving it.
